DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE

International Trade Administration

[C-533-943, C-560-847, C-553-004]


Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled
Into Modules From India, Indonesia, and the Lao People's Democratic
Republic: Countervailing Duty Orders

AGENCY: Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration,
Department of Commerce.

SUMMARY: Based on affirmative final determinations by the U.S.
Department of Commerce (Commerce) and U.S. International Trade
Commission (ITC), Commerce is issuing countervailing duty (CVD) orders
on crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells, whether or not assembled
into modules (solar cells) from India, Indonesia, and the Lao People's
Democratic Republic (Laos).

DATES: Applicable November 9, 2026.

[Individual contact details withheld.]

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

Background

    In accordance with sections 705(d) and 777(i) of the Tariff Act of
1930 as amended (the Act) on September 16, 2026, Commerce published in
the Federal Register its affirmative final determinations in the CVD
investigations of solar cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos.\1\ On
November 2, 2026, the ITC notified Commerce of its final
determinations, pursuant to sections 705(d) of the Act, that an
industry in the United States is materially injured within the meaning
of section 705(b)(1)(A)(i) of the Act by reason of imports of solar
cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos.\2\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \1\ See Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not
Assembled Into Modules, from India: Final Affirmative Countervailing
Duty Determination and the Final Affirmative Critical Circumstances
Determination, in Part, 91 FR 58643 (September 16, 2026) (India
Final Determination); see also Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic
Cells, Whether or Not Assembled Into Modules from Indonesia: Final
Affirmative Countervailing Duty Determination and Final Affirmative
Determination of Critical Circumstances, in Part, 91 FR 58647
(September 16, 2026) (Indonesia Final Determination); and
Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled
Into Modules from the Lao People's Democratic Republic: Final
Affirmative Countervailing Duty Determination and Final Affirmative
Determination of Critical Circumstances, in Part, 91 FR 58638
(September 16, 2026) (Laos Final Determination); and (collectively,
Final Determinations).
    \2\ See ITC's Letter, ``Notification of ITC Final
Determinations,'' dated November 2, 2026.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Scope of the Orders

    The products covered by these orders are solar cells from India,
Indonesia, and Laos. For a full description of the scope of these
orders, see the appendix to this notice.

Countervailing Duty Orders

    Based on the affirmative final determinations by the ITC that an
industry in the United States is materially injured by reason of
subsidized imports of solar cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos,\3\
in accordance with sections 705(c)(2) and 706(a) of the Act, Commerce
is issuing these CVD orders. Because the ITC determined that imports of
solar cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos are materially injuring a
U.S. industry, unliquidated entries of such merchandise entered, or
withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption, are subject to the
assessment of countervailing duties.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \3\ Id.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Therefore, in accordance with section 706(a)(1) of the Act,
Commerce will direct U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to
assess, upon further instructions by Commerce, countervailing duties on
certain unliquidated entries of solar cells from India, Indonesia, and
Laos, that were entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption
on or after February 26, 2026,\4\ the date of publication of the
Preliminary Determinations,\5\ but will not include entries occurring
after the expiration of the provisional measures period and before the
publication of the ITC's final injury determination under section
705(b) of the Act, as further described below.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \4\ In addition, Commerce intends to apply retroactive duties
for certain unliquidated entries of solar cells from Indonesia due
to affirmative findings for critical circumstances. See ``Critical
Circumstances,'' infra.
    \5\ See Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not
Assembled Into Modules, from India: Preliminary Affirmative
Countervailing Duty Determination, Preliminary Affirmative Critical
Circumstances Determination, in Part, and Alignment of Final
Determination with Final Antidumping Duty Determination, 91 FR 9555
(February 26, 2026) (India Preliminary Determination); see also
Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled
Into Modules from Indonesia: Preliminary Affirmative Countervailing
Duty Determination, Preliminary Affirmative Critical Circumstances
Determination, in Part, and Alignment of Final Determination with
Antidumping Duty Determination, 91 FR 9564 (February 26, 2026)
(Indonesia Preliminary Determination); and Crystalline Silicon
Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled Into Modules from the
Lao People's Democratic Republic: Preliminary Affirmative
Countervailing Duty Determination, Preliminary Negative Critical
Circumstances Determination, and Alignment of Final Determination
with Final Antidumping Duty Determination, 91 FR 9568 (February 26,
2026) (Laos Preliminary Determination) (collectively, Preliminary
Determinations).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Critical Circumstances

    In the Final Determinations, Commerce found that critical
circumstances exist with respect to: (1) Mundra Solar Energy Limited
and Mundra Solar PV Limited; \6\ (2) PT Blue Sky Solar Indonesia (Blue
Sky) and all other producers and/or exporters of solar cells from
Indonesia; \7\ and (3)

[[Page 70844]]

Vietnam Sunergy Joint Stock Company and all other producers and/or
exporters of solar cells from Laos.\8\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \6\ See India Final Determination, 91 FR at 58643-58644.
    \7\ See Indonesia Final Determination, 91 FR at 58648.
    \8\ See Laos Final Determination, 91 FR at 58639.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    The ITC found that critical circumstances do not exist with respect
to imports of solar cells from India and Laos. As a result, for India
and Laos, we intend to instruct CBP to lift the suspension of
liquidation and to refund all cash deposits for estimated
countervailing duties with respect to all suspended entries of subject
merchandise entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or
after November 28, 2025 (i.e., 90 days prior to the date of publication
of the India Preliminary Determination and Laos Preliminary
Determination), but before February 26, 2026 (i.e., the date of
publication of the India Preliminary Determination and Laos Preliminary
Determination).
    In addition, the ITC found that critical circumstances do exist
with respect to imports of solar cells from Indonesia. As a result of
Commerce's affirmative critical circumstances determination under
section 705(a)(2) of the Act and the ITC's affirmative critical
circumstances determination under section 705(b)(4)(A) of the Act,
retroactive duties will be applied with respect to suspended entries of
subject merchandise entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for
consumption on or after November 28, 2025 (i.e., 90 days prior to
February 26, 2026, the date of the publication of Indonesia Preliminary
Determination), for imports from Blue Sky and all other producers and/
or exporters of solar cells from Indonesia.\9\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \9\ See Statement of Administrative Action Accompanying the
Uruguay Round Agreements Act, H.R. Doc. 103-316, Vol. 1 (1994) at
876 (``If both agencies make affirmative critical circumstances
determinations in their final investigations, retroactive duties
will be applied for a period ninety days prior to suspension of
liquidation.'').
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Suspension of Liquidation and Cash Deposits

    In accordance with section 706 of the Act, Commerce intends to
instruct CBP to reinstitute the suspension of liquidation of solar
cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos, effective on the date of
publication of the ITC's final affirmative injury determination in the
Federal Register, and to assess, upon further instruction by Commerce,
pursuant to section 706(a)(1) of the Act, countervailing duties on each
entry of subject merchandise in an amount based on the net
countervailable subsidy rates below. These instructions suspending
liquidation will remain in effect until further notice.
    Commerce also intends, pursuant to section 706(a)(1) of the Act, to
instruct CBP to require cash deposits equal to the amounts as indicated
below. Accordingly, effective on the date of publication of the ITC's
final affirmative injury determination in the Federal Register, CBP
will require, at the same time as importers would normally deposit
estimated customs duties on the subject merchandise, a cash deposit for
each entry of subject merchandise equal to the subsidy rates listed
below.\10\ The all-others rates apply to all producers or exporters not
specifically listed below, as appropriate.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \10\ See section 706(a)(3) of the Act.

Provisional Measures

    Section 703(d) of the Act states that the suspension of liquidation
pursuant to an affirmative preliminary determination may not remain in
effect for more than four months. In the underlying investigations,
Commerce published the Preliminary Determinations on February 26,
2026.\11\ As such, the four-month period beginning on the date of the
publication of the Preliminary Determinations ended on June 25, 2026.
Therefore, entries of solar cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos made
on or after June 26, 2026, and prior to the date of publication of the
ITC's final

[[Page 70845]]

determinations in the Federal Register, are not subject to the
assessment of countervailing duties due to Commerce's discontinuation
of the suspension of liquidation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \11\ See Preliminary Determinations.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    In accordance with section 703(d) of the Act, Commerce instructed
CBP to terminate the suspension of liquidation and to liquidate,
without regard to countervailing duties, certain unliquidated entries
of solar cells from India, Indonesia, and Laos entered, or withdrawn
from warehouse, for consumption on or after June 26, 2026, the date on
which the provisional CVD measures expired, until and through the day
preceding the date of publication of the ITC's final injury
determinations in the Federal Register. Suspension of liquidation and
the collection of cash deposits will resume on the date of publication
of the ITC final injury determinations in the Federal Register.

Establishment of the Annual Inquiry Service List

    On September 20, 2021, Commerce published the Final Rule in the
Federal Register.\12\ On September 27, 2021, Commerce also published
the Procedural Guidance in the Federal Register.\13\ The Final Rule and
Procedural Guidance provide that Commerce will maintain an annual
inquiry service list for each order or suspended investigation, and any
interested party submitting a scope ruling application or request for
circumvention inquiry shall serve a copy of the application or request
on the persons on the annual inquiry service list for that order, as
well as any companion order covering the same merchandise from the same
country of origin.\14\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \12\ See Regulations to Improve Administration and Enforcement
of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Laws, 86 FR 52300 (September
20, 2021) (Final Rule).
    \13\ See Scope Ruling Application; Annual Inquiry Service List;
and Informational Sessions, 86 FR 53205 (September 27, 2021)
(Procedural Guidance).
    \14\ Id.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    In accordance with the Procedural Guidance, for orders published in
the Federal Register after November 4, 2021, Commerce will create an
annual inquiry service list segment in Commerce's online e-filing and
document management system, Antidumping and Countervailing Duty
Electronic Service System (ACCESS), available at
https://access.trade.gov
, within five business days of publication of the
order. Each annual inquiry service list will be saved in ACCESS, under
each case number, and under a specific segment type called ``AISL-
Annual Inquiry Service List.'' \15\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \15\ This segment will be combined with the ACCESS Segment
Specific Information (SSI) field which will display the month in
which the notice of the order or suspended investigation was
published in the Federal Register, also known as the anniversary
month. For example, for an order under case number A-000-000 that
was published in the Federal Register in January, the relevant
segment and SSI combination will appear in ACCESS as ``AISL-January
Anniversary.'' Note that there will be only one annual inquiry
service list segment per case number, and the anniversary month will
be pre-populated in ACCESS.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Interested parties who wish to be added to the annual inquiry
service list for an order must submit an entry of appearance to the
annual inquiry service list segment for the order in ACCESS within 30
days after the date of publication of the order. For ease of
administration, Commerce requests that law firms with more than one
attorney representing interested parties in an order designate a lead
attorney to be included on the annual inquiry service list. Commerce
will finalize the annual inquiry service list within five business days
thereafter. As mentioned in the Procedural Guidance, the new annual
inquiry service list will be in place until the following year, when
the Opportunity Notice for the anniversary month of the order is
published.
    Commerce may update an annual inquiry service list at any time as
needed based on interested parties' amendments to their entries of
appearance to remove or otherwise modify their list of members and
representatives, or to update contact information. Any changes or
announcements pertaining to these procedures will be posted to the
ACCESS website.

Special Instructions for Petitioners and Foreign Governments

    In the Final Rule, Commerce stated that, ``after an initial request
and placement on the annual inquiry service list, both petitioners and
foreign governments will automatically be placed on the annual inquiry
service list in the years that follow.'' \16\ Accordingly, as stated
above, the petitioners and foreign governments should submit their
initial entry of appearance after publication of this notice in order
to appear in the first annual inquiry service list. Pursuant to 19 CFR
351.225(n)(3), the petitioners and foreign governments will not need to
resubmit their entries of appearance each year to continue to be
included on the annual inquiry service list. However, the petitioners
and foreign governments are responsible for making amendments to their
entries of appearance during the annual update to the annual inquiry
service list in accordance with the procedures described above.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \16\ See Final Rule, 86 FR at 52335.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Notification to Interested Parties

    This notice constitutes the CVD orders with respect to solar cells
from India, Indonesia, and Laos pursuant to section 706(a) of the Act.
Interested parties can find a list of CVD orders currently in effect at
https://www.trade.gov/data-visualization/adcvd-proceedings
.
    These CVD orders are published in accordance with section 706(a) of
the Act and 19 CFR 351.211(b).

    Dated: November 4, 2026.
Scot Fullerton,
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing
Duty Operations.

Appendix

Scope of the Orders

    The products covered by these orders are crystalline silicon
photovoltaic cells, and modules, laminates, and panels, consisting
of crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells, whether or not partially
or fully assembled into other products, including, but not limited
to, modules, laminates, panels and building integrated materials.
    These orders cover crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells of
thickness equal to or greater than 20 micrometers, having a p/n
junction formed by any means, whether or not the cell has undergone
other processing, including, but not limited to, cleaning, etching,
coating, and/or addition of materials (including, but not limited
to, metallization and conductor patterns) to collect and forward the
electricity that is generated by the cell.
    Merchandise under consideration may be described at the time of
importation as parts for final finished products that are assembled
after importation, including, but not limited to, modules,
laminates, panels, building-integrated modules, building integrated
panels, or other finished goods kits. Such parts that otherwise meet
the definition of merchandise under consideration are included in
the scope of the orders.
    Excluded from the scope of the orders are thin film photovoltaic
products produced from amorphous silicon (a-Si), cadmium telluride
(CdTe), or copper indium gallium selenide (CIGS).
    Also excluded from the scope of the orders are crystalline
silicon photovoltaic cells, not exceeding 10,000 mm\2\ in surface
area, that are permanently integrated into a consumer good whose
function is other than power generation and that consumes the
electricity generated by the integrated crystalline silicon
photovoltaic cell. Where more than one cell is permanently
integrated into a consumer good, the surface area for purposes of
this exclusion shall be the total combined surface area of all cells
that are integrated into the consumer good.

[[Page 70846]]

    Additionally, excluded from the scope of the orders are panels
with surface area from 3,450 mm\2\ to 33,782 mm\2\ with one black
wire and one red wire (each of type 22 AWG or 24 AWG not more than
206 mm in length when measured from panel extrusion), and not
exceeding 2.9 volts, 1.1 amps, and 3.19 watts. For the purposes of
this exclusion, no panel shall contain an internal battery or
external computer peripheral ports.
    Also excluded from the scope of the orders are:
    (1) Off grid CSPV panels in rigid form with a glass cover, with
the following characteristics: (A) a total power output of 100 watts
or less per panel; (B) a maximum surface area of 8,000 cm\2\ per
panel; (C) do not include a built-in inverter; (D) must include a
permanently connected wire that terminates in either an 8 mm male
barrel connector, or a two-port rectangular connector with two pins
in square housings of different colors; (E) must include visible
parallel grid collector metallic wire lines every 1-4 millimeters
across each solar cell; and (F) must be in individual retail
packaging (for purposes of this provision, retail packaging
typically includes graphics, the product name, its description and/
or features, and foam for transport); and
    (2) Off grid CSPV panels without a glass cover, with the
following characteristics: (A) a total power output of 100 watts or
less per panel; (B) a maximum surface area of 8,000 cm\2\ per panel;
(C) do not include a built-in inverter; (D) must include visible
parallel grid collector metallic wire lines every 1-4 millimeters
across each solar cell; and (E) each panel is (1) permanently
integrated into a consumer good; (2) encased in a laminated material
without stitching, or (3) has all of the following characteristics:
(i) the panel is encased in sewn fabric with visible stitching, (ii)
includes a mesh zippered storage pocket, and (iii) includes a
permanently attached wire that terminates in a female USB-A
connector.
    In addition, the following CSPV panels are excluded from the
scope of the orders: off-grid CSPV panels in rigid form with a glass
cover, with each of the following physical characteristics, whether
or not assembled into a fully completed off-grid hydropanel whose
function is conversion of water vapor into liquid water: (A) a total
power output of no more than 80 watts per panel; (B) a surface area
of less than 5,000 square centimeters (cm\2\) per panel; (C) do not
include a built-in inverter; (D) do not have a frame around the
edges of the panel; (E) include a clear glass back panel; and (F)
must include a permanently connected wire that terminates in a
twoport rectangular connector.
    Additionally excluded from the scope of these orders are off-
grid small portable crystalline silicon photovoltaic panels, with or
without a glass cover, with the following characteristics: (1) a
total power output of 200 watts or less per panel; (2) a maximum
surface area of 16,000 cm\2\ per panel; (3) no built-in inverter;
(4) an integrated handle or a handle attached to the package for
ease of carry; (5) one or more integrated kickstands for easy
installation or angle adjustment; and (6) a wire of not less than 3
meters either permanently connected or attached to the package that
terminates in an 8 mm diameter male barrel connector.
    Also excluded from the scope of these orders are off-grid
crystalline silicon photovoltaic panels in rigid form with a glass
cover, with each of the following physical characteristics, whether
or not assembled into a fully completed off-grid hydropanel whose
function is conversion of water vapor into liquid water: (A) a total
power output of no more than 180 watts per panel at 155 degrees
Celsius; (B) a surface area of less than 16,000 square centimeters
(cm\2\) per panel; (C) include a keep-out area of approximately
1,200 cm\2\ around the edges of the panel that does not contain
solar cells; (D) do not include a built-in inverter; (E) do not have
a frame around the edges of the panel; (F) include a clear glass
back panel; (G) must include a permanently connected wire that
terminates in a two-port rounded rectangular, sealed connector; (H)
include a thermistor installed into the permanently connected wire
before the twoport connector; and (I) include exposed positive and
negative terminals at opposite ends of the panel, not enclosed in a
junction box.
    Further excluded from the scope of the orders are:
    (1) Off grid rigid CSPV panels with a glass cover, with the
following characteristics: (A) a total power output of 200 watts or
less per panel, (B) a maximum surface area of 10,500 cm\2\ per
panel, (C) do not include a built-in inverter, (D) must include a
permanently connected wire that terminates in waterproof connector
with a cylindrical positive electrode and a rectangular negative
electrode with the positive and negative electrodes having an
interlocking structure, (E) must include visible parallel grid
collector metallic wire lines every 1-4 millimeters across each
solar cell, and (F) must be in individual retail packaging (for
purposes of this provision, retail packaging typically includes
graphics, the product name, its description and/or features); and
    (2) Off-grid small portable crystalline silicon photovoltaic
panels, with or without a glass cover, with the following
characteristics: (A) a total power output of 200 watts or less per
panel, (B) a maximum surface area of 16,000 cm\2\ per panel, (C) no
built-in inverter, (D) an integrated handle or a handle attached to
the package for ease of carry, (E) one or more integrated kickstands
for easy installation or angle adjustment, and (F) a wire either
permanently connected or attached to the package terminates in
waterproof connector with a cylindrical positive electrode and a
rectangular negative electrode with the positive and negative
electrodes having an interlocking structure.
    Also excluded from the scope of the orders are:
    (1) Off grid rigid CSPV panels with a glass cover, with the
following characteristics: (A) a total power output of 200 watts or
less per panel, (B) a maximum surface area of 10,500 cm\2\ per
panel, (C) do not include a built-in inverter, (D) must include a
permanently connected wire that terminates in waterproof connector
with a cylindrical positive electrode and a rectangular negative
electrode with the positive and negative electrodes having an
interlocking structure, (E) must include visible parallel grid
collector metallic wire lines every 1-4 millimeters across each
solar cell, and (F) must be in individual retail packaging (for
purposes of this provision, retail packaging typically includes
graphics, the product name, its description and/or features); and
    (2) Small off-grid panels with glass cover, with the following
characteristics: (A) surface area from 3,450 mm\2\ to 33,782 mm\2\,
(B) with one black wire and one red wire (each of type 22AWG or 28
AWG not more than 350 mm in length when measured from panel
extrusion), (C) not exceeding 10 volts, (D) not exceeding 1.1 amps,
(E) not exceeding 6 watts, and (F) for the purposes of this
exclusion, no panel shall contain an internal battery or external
computer peripheral ports.
    Additionally excluded from the scope of the orders are:
    (1) Off grid rigid CSPV panels with a glass cover, with the
following characteristics: (A) a total power output of 175 watts or
less per panel, (B) a maximum surface area of 9,000 cm\2\ per panel,
(C) do not include a built-in inverter, (D) must include a
permanently connected wire that terminates in waterproof connector
with a cylindrical positive electrode and a rectangular negative
electrode with the positive and negative electrodes having an
interlocking structure; (E) must include visible parallel grid
collector metallic wire lines every 1-4 millimeters across each
solar cell, and (F) must be in individual retail packaging (for
purposes of this provision, retail packaging typically includes
graphics, the product name, its description and/or features); and
    (2) Off grid CSPV panels without a glass cover, with the
following characteristics, (A) a total power output of 220 watts or
less per panel, (B) a maximum surface area of 16,000 cm\2\ per
panel, (C) do not include a built-in inverter, (D) must include
visible parallel grid collector metallic wire lines every 1-4
millimeters across each solar cell, and (E) each panel is encased in
a laminated material without stitching.
    Also excluded from the scope of these orders are off-grid CSPV
panels in rigid form, with or without a glass cover, permanently
attached to an aluminum extrusion that is an integral component of
an automation device that controls natural light, whether or not
assembled into a fully completed automation device that controls
natural light, with the following characteristics:
    (1) a total power output of 20 watts or less per panel;
    (2) a maximum surface area of 1,000 cm\2\ per panel;
    (3) does not include a built-in inverter for powering third
party devices.
    Modules, laminates, and panels produced in a third-country from
cells produced in a subject country are covered by the orders;
however, modules, laminates, and panels produced in a subject
country from cells produced in a third-country are not covered by
the orders.
    Also excluded from the scope of this orders are all products
covered by the scope of the antidumping and countervailing duty
orders on Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not
Assembled into Modules,

[[Page 70847]]

from the People's Republic of China: Amended Final Determination of
Sales at Less Than Fair Value, and Antidumping Order, 77 FR 73018
(December 7, 2012); and Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells,
Whether or Not Assembled into Modules, from the People's Republic of
China: Countervailing Duty Order, 77 FR 73017 (December 7, 2012).
    Also excluded from the scope of these orders are all products
covered by the scope of the antidumping and countervailing duty
orders on Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not
Assembled into Modules from the Socialist Republic of Vietnam:
Amended Final Antidumping Duty Determination; Crystalline Silicon
Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled into Modules from
Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam:
Antidumping duty Orders, 90 FR 26786 (June 24, 2025); Crystalline
Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled into Modules
from the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Amended Final Antidumping
Duty Determination; Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether
or Not Assembled into Modules from Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, and
the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Antidumping Duty Orders;
Correction, 90 FR 29843 (July 7, 2025); and Crystalline Silicon
Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled into Modules, from
Malaysia and Thailand: Amended Final Countervailing Duty
Determinations; Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or
Not Assembled into Modules, from Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, and
the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Countervailing Duty Orders, 90 FR
26791 (June 24, 2025).
    Merchandise covered by the orders is currently classified in the
Harmonized Tariff System of the United States (HTSUS) under
subheadings 8541.42.0010 and 8541.43.0010. Imports of the subject
merchandise may enter under HTSUS subheadings 8501.71.0000,
8501.72.1000, 8501.72.2000, 8501.72.3000, 8501.72.9000,
8501.80.1000, 8501.80.2000, 8501.80.3000, 8501.80.9000,
8507.20.8010, 8507.20.8031, 8507.20.8041, 8507.20.8061, and
8507.20.8091. These HTSUS subheadings are provided for convenience
and customs purposes; the written description of the scope of the
orders is dispositive.

**要旨・適用日**　米商務省と米国際貿易委員会（ITC）の肯定的最終決定に基づき、商務省は三カ国産の結晶シリコン太陽電池に相殺関税（CVD）命令を発出する。適用日は2026年11月9日。

**背景・対象**　1930年関税法第705条(d)、第777条(i)に従い、商務省は2026年9月16日、三カ国産太陽電池に対する相殺関税調査の肯定的最終決定を官報に掲載した［1］。11月2日、ITCは第705条(d)に基づき、三カ国からの輸入が同法第705条(b)(1)(A)(i)の意味で米国内産業に実質的な損害を与えているとの最終決定を商務省に通知した［2］。完全な対象品目の定義は付録にある。

**命令**　ITCが三カ国からの補助金付き輸入が米国内産業に実質的な損害を与えると肯定的に最終決定したため、商務省は第705条(c)(2)と第706条(a)に従い命令を発出する［3］。国内消費向けに輸入申告、または保税倉庫から引き取った未確定通関分は相殺関税の賦課対象となる。第706条(a)(1)に従い、商務省は追加指示後にCBPが、暫定決定を掲載した2026年2月26日以降の該当する未確定分に賦課するよう指示する［4–5］。暫定措置終了からITCの最終損害決定の官報掲載までの間の輸入は除く。

**緊急事態（次頁に続く）**　商務省は最終決定で、インドのMundra Solar Energy LimitedとMundra Solar PV Limited、インドネシアのPT Blue Sky Solar Indonesiaおよびその他の生産者・輸出者について緊急事態が存在すると認定した［6–7］。

## PDF 2頁（官報70844頁）

**緊急事態（続き）**　商務省はラオスのVietnam Sunergy Joint Stock Companyおよびその他の生産者・輸出者についても緊急事態が存在すると認定した［8］。ITCはインドおよびラオスからの輸入については緊急事態が存在しないと判断した。したがって商務省は、両国について、暫定決定の90日前に当たる2025年11月28日から2026年2月26日の暫定決定掲載前までに輸入申告または保税倉庫から引き取られ、税額確定が停止されていた分の停止を解除し、推定相殺関税の現金供託をすべて返還するようCBPに指示する意向である。

インドネシアについて、ITCは緊急事態が存在すると判断した。商務省とITCの双方の肯定的判断に基づき、PT Blue Sky Solar Indonesiaとその他の該当生産者・輸出者の、暫定決定掲載の90日前である2025年11月28日以降の税額確定停止分に遡及賦課する［9］。

**税額確定の停止と現金供託**　第706条に従い、商務省はITCの肯定的最終損害決定の官報掲載日から、対象品の税額確定を停止するようCBPに指示する意向である。商務省の追加指示により、各輸入申告に下表の純相殺可能補助率に基づく税額を賦課する。停止は別途通知まで有効。同じ掲載日から、通常の推定関税の供託と同時に、各申告について表の補助率に相当する現金供託を求める［10］。「その他」は個別に列挙されていない生産者または輸出者に適用する。

| 原産国 | 会社 | 従価補助率 |
|---|---|---:|
| インド | Mundra Solar Energy Limited | 126.09%* |
| インド | Mundra Solar PV Limited | 126.09%* |
| インド | その他 | 126.09%* |
| インドネシア | PT Blue Sky Solar Indonesia | 173.70%* |
| インドネシア | PT REC Solar Energy Indonesia | 73.20% |
| インドネシア | その他 | 73.20% |
| ラオス | Solarspace Technology (Laos) Sole Co. Ltd. | 82.03% |
| ラオス | Vietnam Sunergy Joint Stock Company | 153.67%* |
| ラオス | その他 | 82.03% |

*印は、不利な推定を伴う利用可能な事実に基づく税率。

**暫定措置（次頁に続く）**　関税法第703条(d)により、肯定的暫定決定による税額確定停止は4カ月を超えられない。2026年2月26日に暫定決定が公表されたため、4カ月の期間は6月25日に終了した［11］。

## PDF 3頁（官報70845頁）

**暫定措置（続き）**　2026年6月26日以降、ITCの最終決定の官報掲載前に行われた三カ国の対象輸入は、税額確定停止の中断により相殺関税の賦課対象から外れる。第703条(d)に従い、商務省はCBPに、暫定措置終了後の6月26日からITCの最終損害決定官報掲載日前日までの該当未確定分について、確定停止を解除して相殺関税を考慮せず税額を確定するよう指示した。税額確定の停止と現金供託はITCの最終損害決定の官報掲載日に再開する。

**付録の対象品目冒頭**　対象は結晶シリコン太陽電池と、その電池からなるモジュール、ラミネート、パネルであり、他製品へ部分的または完全に組み込んだものも含む。厚さ20マイクロメートル以上の結晶シリコン太陽電池で、形成方法を問わずp/n接合を持つものが対象。洗浄、エッチング、コーティング、発電した電気の集電・送電用の材料（メタライゼーションや導体パターンなど）の追加など、その後の加工の有無を問わない。輸入時に、輸入後に組み立てる最終完成品（モジュール、ラミネート、パネル、建材一体型モジュール・パネル、その他の完成品キット等）の部品と記載されても、定義に該当すれば対象となる。

アモルファスシリコン（a-Si）、テルル化カドミウム（CdTe）、銅・インジウム・ガリウム・セレン化物（CIGS）による薄膜型太陽光発電製品は対象外。

**消費財への組込みによる除外。** 面積が10,000平方ミリメートル以下で、発電以外の機能を持ち、組み込んだ結晶シリコン太陽電池が発生させた電力を消費する消費財に恒久的に組み込まれるセルは除外する。複数のセルが恒久的に組み込まれる場合は、組み込まれた全セルの合計面積で判定する。

## PDF 4頁（官報70846頁）

**寸法と配線による除外。** 面積3,450〜33,782平方ミリメートルで、22 AWGまたは24 AWGの黒線と赤線を各1本備え、パネルの押出部材から測った各線の長さが206ミリメートル以下で、2.9ボルト・1.1アンペア・3.19ワットを超えないパネルは除外する。この除外には、内蔵電池と外部コンピューター周辺機器用ポートがないことを要する。

**100ワット以下の独立型パネル。**

1. ガラスカバー付きの剛性型。1枚の総出力100ワット以下、最大表面積8,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。恒久配線の先端は、8ミリメートルの雄型バレルコネクターか、色の異なる角形ハウジングに2本のピンを備える2ポート長方形コネクターとする。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。この包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴、輸送用の発泡材が含まれる。
2. ガラスカバーなし。1枚の総出力100ワット以下、最大表面積8,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見えること。各パネルは、消費財に恒久的に組み込まれるか、縫い目のない積層材で覆われるか、次の3条件をすべて満たす。縫い目が見える縫製布で覆われ、ファスナー付きのメッシュ収納ポケットを備え、雌型USB-Aコネクターで終わる恒久配線を備える。

**水蒸気を液体の水に変える装置用の80ワット型。** ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型パネルで、完成した独立型造水装置への組立ての有無にかかわらず、次をすべて満たすものを除外する。1枚80ワット以下、表面積5,000平方センチメートル未満、内蔵インバーターなし、縁に枠なし、背面は透明ガラス、恒久配線の先端は2ポート長方形コネクター。

**8ミリメートル接続の小型携帯型。** ガラスカバーの有無を問わず、1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積16,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし、持ち運び用の一体型または包装取付けの取っ手、設置・角度調整用の一体型スタンド1個以上を備えるもの。恒久接続または包装に付属する長さ3メートル以上の線の先端は、直径8ミリメートルの雄型バレルコネクターとする。

**造水装置用の高温仕様。** ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型パネルで、完成した独立型造水装置への組立ての有無を問わない。155℃で1枚180ワット以下、表面積16,000平方センチメートル未満、パネル周縁に太陽電池を配置しない約1,200平方センチメートルの領域があること。内蔵インバーターと周縁の枠がなく、背面は透明ガラス。恒久配線は、角が丸い長方形で密封型の2ポートコネクターで終端し、コネクターの手前にサーミスターを備える。パネルの両端に、接続箱に収納されていない露出した正極と負極を備える。

**防水コネクターを使う200ワット型。**

1. ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型。1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積10,500平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。恒久配線の先端に円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う防水コネクターを備える。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴が含まれる。
2. ガラスカバーの有無を問わない小型携帯型。1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積16,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。持ち運び用の一体型または包装取付けの取っ手、設置・角度調整用の一体型スタンド1個以上を備える。恒久接続または包装に付属する線の先端に、円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う防水コネクターを備える。

**続く除外項目。**

1. 官報はガラスカバー付き剛性独立型の条件を再掲する。1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積10,500平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし、円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う防水コネクター付きの恒久配線。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴が含まれる。

**小型独立型パネルの除外条件。** 面積3,450〜33,782平方ミリメートル。黒線と赤線を各1本備え、線材は22 AWGまたは28 AWGで、パネルの押出部材から測った長さは各350ミリメートル以下。10ボルト以下、1.1アンペア以下、6ワット以下。内蔵電池および外部コンピューター周辺機器用ポートを備えないこと。

**追加の除外。**

1. ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型結晶シリコン太陽光パネル。1枚175ワット以下、表面積9,000平方センチメートル以下、内蔵インバーターなし。恒久的に接続された配線の先端に、円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う構造の防水コネクターを備える。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔で平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。小売包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴が含まれる。
2. ガラスカバーなしの独立型結晶シリコン太陽光パネル。1枚220ワット以下、表面積16,000平方センチメートル以下、内蔵インバーターなし。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔で平行な金属集電線が見え、縫い目のない積層材で各パネルが覆われていること。

さらに、自然光を制御する自動装置の一体部品であるアルミ押出部材に恒久的に取り付けられた剛性独立型結晶シリコン太陽光パネルは、ガラスカバーの有無や完成装置への組立ての有無を問わず、1枚20ワット以下、表面積1,000平方センチメートル以下、第三者機器への給電用内蔵インバーターを備えない場合に除外される。

**セルの生産国。** 対象国で生産したセルを用い、第三国で製造したモジュール、ラミネートおよびパネルは命令の対象となる。第三国で生産したセルを用い、対象国で製造したこれらの製品は命令の対象外となる。既存の中国向け命令による除外は次頁に続く。

## PDF 5頁（官報70847頁）

（中国向け既存命令の除外は前頁からの続き。）

**既存の中国向け命令による除外。** 中国産の結晶シリコン太陽電池（モジュールへの組立ての有無を問わない）に関する次の反ダンピング税・相殺関税命令の対象品は、今回の命令の対象外とする。公正価額未満販売に関する修正最終決定および反ダンピング税命令（2012年12月7日、77 FR 73018）と、相殺関税命令（同日、77 FR 73017）。

**東南アジアの既存命令による除外。** ベトナム産の同製品に関する修正最終反ダンピング決定と、カンボジア、マレーシア、タイ、ベトナム産の同製品に関する反ダンピング税命令（2025年6月24日、90 FR 26786）、その訂正（2025年7月7日、90 FR 29843）、マレーシア・タイ産に関する修正最終相殺関税決定と、同4カ国産に関する相殺関税命令（2025年6月24日、90 FR 26791）の対象品も、今回の命令の対象外とする。

**米国統一関税率表（HTSUS）。** 現在の分類は8541.42.0010および8541.43.0010。対象品の輸入には、8501.71.0000、8501.72.1000、8501.72.2000、8501.72.3000、8501.72.9000、8501.80.1000、8501.80.2000、8501.80.3000、8501.80.9000、8507.20.8010、8507.20.8031、8507.20.8041、8507.20.8061、8507.20.8091が用いられる場合もある。これらの細分類は便宜と通関のための表示であり、適用範囲は命令本文の記述で決まる。

**寸法と配線による除外。** 面積3,450〜33,782平方ミリメートルで、22 AWGまたは24 AWGの黒線と赤線を各1本備え、パネルの押出部材から測った各線の長さが206ミリメートル以下で、2.9ボルト・1.1アンペア・3.19ワットを超えないパネルは除外する。この除外には、内蔵電池と外部コンピューター周辺機器用ポートがないことを要する。

1. ガラスカバー付きの剛性型。1枚の総出力100ワット以下、最大表面積8,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。恒久配線の先端は、8ミリメートルの雄型バレルコネクターか、色の異なる角形ハウジングに2本のピンを備える2ポート長方形コネクターとする。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。この包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴、輸送用の発泡材が含まれる。
2. ガラスカバーなし。1枚の総出力100ワット以下、最大表面積8,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見えること。各パネルは、消費財に恒久的に組み込まれるか、縫い目のない積層材で覆われるか、次の3条件をすべて満たす。縫い目が見える縫製布で覆われ、ファスナー付きのメッシュ収納ポケットを備え、雌型USB-Aコネクターで終わる恒久配線を備える。

**水蒸気を液体の水に変える装置用の80ワット型。** ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型パネルで、完成した独立型造水装置への組立ての有無にかかわらず、次をすべて満たすものを除外する。1枚80ワット以下、表面積5,000平方センチメートル未満、内蔵インバーターなし、縁に枠なし、背面は透明ガラス、恒久配線の先端は2ポート長方形コネクター。

**8ミリメートル接続の小型携帯型。** ガラスカバーの有無を問わず、1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積16,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし、持ち運び用の一体型または包装取付けの取っ手、設置・角度調整用の一体型スタンド1個以上を備えるもの。恒久接続または包装に付属する長さ3メートル以上の線の先端は、直径8ミリメートルの雄型バレルコネクターとする。

**造水装置用の高温仕様。** ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型パネルで、完成した独立型造水装置への組立ての有無を問わない。155℃で1枚180ワット以下、表面積16,000平方センチメートル未満、パネル周縁に太陽電池を配置しない約1,200平方センチメートルの領域があること。内蔵インバーターと周縁の枠がなく、背面は透明ガラス。恒久配線は、角が丸い長方形で密封型の2ポートコネクターで終端し、コネクターの手前にサーミスターを備える。パネルの両端に、接続箱に収納されていない露出した正極と負極を備える。

**防水コネクターを使う200ワット型。**

1. ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型。1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積10,500平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。恒久配線の先端に円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う防水コネクターを備える。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴が含まれる。
2. ガラスカバーの有無を問わない小型携帯型。1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積16,000平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし。持ち運び用の一体型または包装取付けの取っ手、設置・角度調整用の一体型スタンド1個以上を備える。恒久接続または包装に付属する線の先端に、円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う防水コネクターを備える。

**続く除外項目。**

1. 官報はガラスカバー付き剛性独立型の条件を再掲する。1枚200ワット以下、最大表面積10,500平方センチメートル、内蔵インバーターなし、円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う防水コネクター付きの恒久配線。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔の平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴が含まれる。

**小型独立型パネルの除外条件。** 面積3,450〜33,782平方ミリメートル。黒線と赤線を各1本備え、線材は22 AWGまたは28 AWGで、パネルの押出部材から測った長さは各350ミリメートル以下。10ボルト以下、1.1アンペア以下、6ワット以下。内蔵電池および外部コンピューター周辺機器用ポートを備えないこと。

**追加の除外。**

1. ガラスカバー付きの剛性独立型結晶シリコン太陽光パネル。1枚175ワット以下、表面積9,000平方センチメートル以下、内蔵インバーターなし。恒久的に接続された配線の先端に、円筒形の正極と長方形の負極がかみ合う構造の防水コネクターを備える。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔で平行な金属集電線が見え、個別の小売包装に入っていること。小売包装には通常、図柄、製品名、説明や特徴が含まれる。
2. ガラスカバーなしの独立型結晶シリコン太陽光パネル。1枚220ワット以下、表面積16,000平方センチメートル以下、内蔵インバーターなし。各セルに1〜4ミリメートル間隔で平行な金属集電線が見え、縫い目のない積層材で各パネルが覆われていること。

さらに、自然光を制御する自動装置の一体部品であるアルミ押出部材に恒久的に取り付けられた剛性独立型結晶シリコン太陽光パネルは、ガラスカバーの有無や完成装置への組立ての有無を問わず、1枚20ワット以下、表面積1,000平方センチメートル以下、第三者機器への給電用内蔵インバーターを備えない場合に除外される。

**セルの生産国。** 対象国で生産したセルを用い、第三国で製造したモジュール、ラミネートおよびパネルは命令の対象となる。第三国で生産したセルを用い、対象国で製造したこれらの製品は命令の対象外となる。既存の中国向け命令による除外は次頁に続く。
